name: Deore II seven-speed Hyperglide cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 325 g for the CS-MT62 seven-speed 13–30T cassette, with 13/15/17/20/23/26/30T sprockets and spacers. Lockring inclusion is assumed under the catalogue guidelines; the separately listed 12–28T configuration is not the weighed reference.

sources.title: Original Shimano 1989 catalogue (copyright August 1988), PDF page 27: Deore II CS-MT62, 325 g including sprockets and spacers, exact seven-speed 13–30T reference
